reference: Area-weighted horizontal mean of Vsv at each source depth, excluding the duplicated longitude endpoint. This display reference is not STW105, the inversion's reference model.
quantity: 100 * (Vsv / mean Vsv at the same depth - 1)
interpretation: Seismic inverse model, not a photograph or temperature measurement. Smooth interpolation does not add resolving power. Only the mantle portion of the schematic geometry is sampled; depths outside 10–2890 km are gray. Crust and core remain schematic.
longitudeSeam: Average the coincident -180/+180 degree source samples before periodic sampling; their maximum published difference is 0.080645084 km/s, at 20 km depth and 55 degrees north.
